headline: IEA Warns Global Gas Crunch Could Last Until 2027
summary: The International Energy Agency reported that the global gas market could remain tight well into next year as Europe enters the heating season with historically low gas storage levels.
why: The International Energy Agency provides policy recommendations and data on the global energy sector, making its supply outlooks critical for energy markets and utilities.
why_moved: A prolonged global gas crunch and low storage levels constrain available energy supplies, directly supporting upward pressure on natural gas prices.
